snippet.title: DK64: Recompiled Announcement (DK64 PC Port!)
snippet.description:
Announcing DK64: Recompiled by Rainchus! Soon you can play DK64 natively on Windows, MacOS and Linux with high framerate and widescreen support!

Will also support add-on mods, such as Tag Anywhere, quality of life changes and DK64 Randomizer!

Based off of the "N64: Recompiled" project https://github.com/N64Recomp/N64Recomp

Development by Rainchus, Ballaam, Killklli and Umed
Video and footage by 2dos

Made with years of DK64 back-end experience without relying on AI vibe coding.
